main.description:
A TypeScript tool the agent runtime can invoke. The record carries the FULL source: the tool's main.ts, its deno.json, and optionally its deno.lock. When an agent is spawned, the runtime materializes each tool referenced by the agent's skills into a fresh tempdir alongside the agent's main.ts so the spawned Deno process can either dynamically `import()` the tool (in-process) or invoke its CLI entry as a subprocess.

A tool's main.ts SHOULD export a default async function with signature `(args: { input, bridge, config }) => Promise<unknown>` so the parent agent_template can invoke it in-process and share its SubprocessBridge for event bubbling.

name.description: Tool identifier (also the directory name when materialized: tempdir/tools/<name>/main.ts). Must be a valid OpenAI tool name (alphanumeric+underscore).

description.description: Prose description of what the tool does.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the tool's input arguments object.

spawnsSubAgent.description: If true, the tool spawns a nested sub-agent (a fresh Deno process with its own ATProto identity). The runtime sets up a unix-socket bridge so orchestrator events from the sub-agent bubble back into the parent's FlowContext.

source.description: Full main.ts source. Materialized verbatim to tempdir/tools/<name>/main.ts at spawn time.

denoJson.description: Full deno.json content for this tool's project root. If absent, the runtime uses a minimal default.

denoLock.description: Full deno.lock content (pinned dependency hashes). Recommended for reproducibility across spawn locations.
